description: Example Cloud Firewall allow/deny list template. Replace CIDR placeholders with actual documented ranges.

allow_list.name: allow-https-inbound
allow_list.notes: Public HTTPS entry point to the load balancer / bastion only, never directly to private subnet instances.

allow_list.name: allow-admin-vpn
allow_list.notes: Restrict to the known administrative IP range, not the whole internet.

deny_list.name: deny-known-bad-range
deny_list.notes: Populate from threat intelligence feed or known malicious ranges relevant to this deployment.
